course.title: Regional Development Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: What are the factors that influence the required fleet strength of urban bus (12) service? It is observed that in the morning peak flow operation from Fultala to Rupsha bus route there require to carry 5000 passengers. How many buses would be needed to accommodate morning peak flow with a bus having 50 seats? Consider the load factor 1.0; speed of the bus 25 km/hr; length of the route 25 km. Also find out the resulting average headway.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
